Summarize AIPW or regression adjustment weights

Source: R/twfeweights_mp.R
summary.decomposed_aipw.Rd

Prints the estimate of \(ATT^o\) from implicit_aipw_weights() and an effective sample size for the comparison group, and returns either the \((g,t)\)-level estimates or, after aipw_cov_bal(), a covariate balance table.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'decomposed_aipw'
summary(object, ...)

Arguments

object

A decomposed_aipw object.

...

Not used.

Value

A data.frame. Before aipw_cov_bal(): one row per post-treatment \((g,t)\) cell with the estimate and its weight in \(ATT^o\). After: one row per covariate with unweighted and weighted means for the treated and comparison groups, their differences and the other balance statistics, averaged over cells using the \(ATT^o\) weights.

Examples

data(castle, package = "causaldata")
castle <- as.data.frame(castle)
castle$G <- BMisc::get_group(castle, "sid", tname = "year", treatname = "post")
ra <- implicit_aipw_weights(
  yname = "l_homicide", tname = "year", idname = "sid", gname = "G",
  xformula = ~l_police, pscore_formula = ~1, data = castle
)
